title.zh: 面部控制的覆盖：ARKit / MediaPipe 的系数 vs 我们的动作单元
title.en: Coverage of facial controls: ARKit / MediaPipe coefficients vs our action units

method.zh: 逐个系数（ARKit 的 52 个标识符），列出我们哪个 AU 表达同一个动作、这些 AU 在两副身体上驱动哪些肌肉通道；再反过来逐个 AU 列出对应的系数。对应关系是本项目做的，依据系数的一句话定义和 ICT-FaceKit 给自己形状的 FACS 对照表。covered = 有同样的控制；partial = 有，但我们只有双侧同时动（或定义不完全相同）；none = 没有。没有单独对应系数的 AU 列在 summary.ourAusWithout 里（例如 AU23 唇收紧，ARKit 最接近的是 mouthPress；AU25 唇分开，最接近的是 jawOpen 减去 mouthClose）。AU 的集合读自当前的 face.json；对应表里列的 AU 不在其中时该行记为 none。下载存在时，系数名与 Apple 文档 JSON、MediaPipe 源码里的名单逐一核对，结果写在 inArkitDocs / inMediaPipe。
method.en: For each coefficient (the 52 ARKit identifiers): which of our AUs expresses the same movement and which muscle channels those AUs drive on the two bodies; then the reverse, per AU. The mapping is this project's, based on the one-line definition of each coefficient and on the FACS table ICT-FaceKit gives for its own shapes. covered = the same control exists; partial = it exists, but ours moves both sides together (or the definition differs somewhat); none = absent. AUs without a coefficient of their own are listed in summary.ourAusWithout (for example AU23, lip tightener, whose nearest is mouthPress, and AU25, lips part, whose nearest is jawOpen less mouthClose). The set of AUs is read from the current face.json; a row whose mapped AU is not in it becomes none. When the downloads are present the names are checked one by one against Apple's documentation JSON and the list in MediaPipe's source, recorded in inArkitDocs / inMediaPipe.

tolerance.zh: 不是数值比较：covered / partial 记 within，none 记 outside。
tolerance.en: Not a numeric comparison: covered / partial count as within, none as outside.

notes.zh: OpenRigLogic（MetaHuman 面部解算器的开源部分）没有可比的控制名单：仓库里只有读 DNA 文件和求值的代码与文档，原始控制（raw control）和界面控制（GUI control）的名字存在每个角色的 DNA 文件的 Definition 层里（DefinitionReader::getRawControlName / getGUIControlName），仓库里没有任何 .dna 文件，也没有控制名的清单。按要求没有下载 MetaHuman 的 DNA，所以“它有哪些控制、张成怎样的 FACS 集合”这一问没有回答。从它的设计文档能读到的只有结构：输入是表情级的控制值 → PSD（多个控制相乘得到的组合/修正表情）→ 关节变换、混合形状权重、动画贴图系数；没有肌肉层。
notes.en: OpenRigLogic (the open part of the MetaHuman facial solver) offers no comparable list of controls: the repository holds only the code and documentation that read a DNA file and evaluate it, while the names of raw controls and GUI controls live in the Definition layer of each character's DNA file (DefinitionReader::getRawControlName / getGUIControlName); the repository contains no .dna file and no list of control names. As instructed, no MetaHuman DNA was downloaded, so the question of which controls exist and what FACS-like set they span is left unanswered. What its design document does give is the structure: expression-level control values in → PSDs (combination / corrective expressions formed as products of controls) → joint transforms, blend-shape weights and animated-map multipliers; there is no muscle layer.

notes.zh: MediaPipe 的名单是 "_neutral" 加 51 个 ARKit 名，没有 tongueOut；所以两个“52”不是同一个集合。ICT-FaceKit 没有 tongueOut，另把 browInnerUp、cheekPuff 分成左右，并多出 cheekRaiser、PupilDilate。
notes.en: MediaPipe's list is "_neutral" plus 51 ARKit names, without tongueOut, so the two "52"s are not the same set. ICT-FaceKit has no tongueOut, splits browInnerUp and cheekPuff into left and right, and adds cheekRaiser and PupilDilate.

notes.zh: Apple 的文档只把系数定义为 0.0（中性）到 1.0（最大运动），不给位移的度量；这里只读了索引页的 JSON，没有逐个打开 52 个系数页。
notes.en: Apple's documentation defines a coefficient only as 0.0 (neutral) to 1.0 (maximum movement) and gives no metric displacement; only the index page's JSON was read, not the 52 per-coefficient pages.
